scope: EVERY live (non-evidence) site in this repository that handed a bare path to node's ESM loader, or hand-built a `file://` URL by concatenation. The two production MCP launchers were fixed in the previous commit (184fb1b9); this one covers the QA/tooling band.

fixed.what: `await import(join(QA_LIB, "credentials.ts"|"dsh-launcher.ts"|"workspace-isolation.ts"|"session-evidence.ts"))` -> `await import(pathToFileURL(join(QA_LIB, "…")).href)`; `pathToFileURL` added to the existing `node:url` import.
fixed.whyItMattered: This is the AGENTS.md §4 verification-law falsifier, run as `node skills/dsh-qa/scripts/verify-law.ts`. Its four top-level `await import`s execute BEFORE any arm, so on Windows the whole gate died with ERR_UNSUPPORTED_ESM_URL_SCHEME.

fixed.what: The AUTHORED twin of the file above, synced byte-for-byte from the registered copy.
fixed.whyItMattered: The case body exists TWICE and the self-test has an ANTI-DRIFT arm comparing `fileURLToPath(import.meta.url)` with the registered copy. That arm is vacuous when run from the registered copy (same path) and only bites when run from the AUTHORED copy — which is exactly how editing only the skills copy would have shipped a drifted pair. Both copies are now byte-identical (verified by hash) and the authored-side arm passes.

fixed.what: `await import(PATHS.webRoute)`, `PATHS.webHarness`, `PATHS.tuiWatchdog`. `PATHS.*` are BARE PATHS (`join(REPO, …)` in `./lib/watchdog-lane.ts`), so all three are now wrapped in `pathToFileURL(...)`; `node:url` imported.
`const url = (relative) => "file://" + join(hostRoot, relative)` -> `pathToFileURL(join(hostRoot, relative)).href` (`pathToFileURL` was already imported).
fixed.whyItMattered: A HAND-BUILT file URL: `"file://" + join(root, …)` is correct only on POSIX, where the joined path starts with `/` (giving `file:///…`). On win32 it yields `file://C:\…`, whose HOST is the string `C:\…` and whose path is empty — so all three `await import(url(...))` calls below it could never resolve a module.
The same hand-built-URL defect; this one loads the HOST's own pinned manifest parser, so on Windows the lane could not evaluate its manifest arm at all.

checkedAndDeliberatelyNotChanged.why: NOT a defect: `lib` is already `pathToFileURL(join(REPO, …)).href` (line 152) — the pattern is correct there.

`const url = "file://" + svnRepo` — the SAME smell but a DIFFERENT mechanism: this string is an **svn CLI argument**, not an ESM specifier, so it throws no ESM error. On Windows svn would want `file:///C:/…`. It was NOT changed because it cannot be verified on this machine (no svn host / no SVN backend to exercise) and a wrong edit would silently break the plugin's `memory.vcs=svn` mode. FLAGGED for a host that can test it.
Historical records and a test fixture; evidence files are provenance and must stay byte-verbatim, and the test's `file://` is likewise an svn argument.

Those run under BUN (`bun test`), whose resolver accepts an absolute Windows path in `import()`; only NODE rejects it. They are left as-is (and three of them were already made win32-portable for the host-root reason in commit 9c14c15e).
